sources.entry: HTS for Mac - Read-only Korean and US stock workspace in the style of Windows HTS apps, with a 10-level order book, four-chart layouts, watchlists and saved workspaces; live quotes need your own Kiwoom REST API key. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A read-only Korean and US stock viewer for macOS that runs in the browser and mimics Windows HTS (home trading system) apps, connecting to live quotes through the user's own Kiwoom REST API key.
summary.what_it_does: Shows domestic (Korean) and US stock quotes, a 10-level order book, and market executions, with KRW/USD distinction. Charts support 4-chart layouts, minute/day/week/month/year candles, indicators, drawing tools, and relative-return comparison of up to 4 symbols. Users can create watchlist groups, four workspaces with detachable/linked/pinned windows, and save or restore layouts. Analysis screens cover domestic rankings and flows, program/ETF/theme data, saved Kiwoom condition searches, and watchlist filters, alerts, and memos. It does not offer trading, orders, transfers, or personal account lookups. The README says it ships a synthetic test-data mode that needs no API key.
use_cases: Check Korean and US stock quotes on a Mac without Windows or Parallels
Compare charts of several stocks or timeframes side by side
Manage watchlists and saved screen layouts for market research
Browse domestic stock rankings, flows, and ETF/theme data
Run a read-only stock analysis workspace alongside a separate brokerage app
Try the interface with synthetic data before connecting a Kiwoom API key
how_to_run: Enter Kiwoom App Key and App Secret in the in-app API connection settings (keys are never committed to Git)
notable: Read-only by design: no buy, sell, modify, cancel, auto-trading, or transfer features
Four-chart layout with cross-window symbol linking and comparison of up to 4 symbols' relative returns
Works with a built-in synthetic-data mode before any real API key is set
API keys stored in macOS Keychain with automatic access-token renewal and expiry reminders
Optional DART (OpenDART key) and SEC (User-Agent) data sources for disclosures and financials
caveats: Live quotes require the user's own Kiwoom account, REST API application, IP whitelisting, and API key; not an official Kiwoom product
Source-install pre-release only; no signed standalone macOS app; some Kiwoom endpoints (after-hours order book and rankings, US watchlist aggregate) are explicitly rejected by Kiwoom and show errors
Requires specific Node.js versions (22.13+ 22.x, 24.x, or 26+; 23.x and 25.x unsupported) plus git, uv, and npm; local 127.0.0.1 only
keywords: how to view stock charts on mac
